# @fmatar/agentic-sdlc (v0.3.0)

> Zero-dependency Alignment and Proof Kernel for AI coding agents (Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot) enforcing Git Flow session guards, Spec/ADR alignment, [Archlens](https://github.com/fmatar/archlens) Concentric Clean Architecture rings, measured diff coverage & mutation gates, and HMAC-SHA256 merge receipts.

## Core Documentation

- [README.md](./README.md): Quickstart, 8-module Concentric Kernel architecture, and 6-skill suite overview
- [PRODUCT.md](./PRODUCT.md): Constitutional invariants (`INV-01`..`INV-04`), capability matrix (`CAP-01`..`CAP-06`), and ADR index
- [GLOSSARY.md](./GLOSSARY.md): Ubiquitous domain vocabulary for Proof Kernel, sessions, seams, and receipts
- [docs/PRD.md](./docs/PRD.md): Product Requirements Document (`v0.1.0`)
- [docs/SRS.md](./docs/SRS.md): IEEE 29148 Software Requirements Specification & compacted ADR lineage
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md): Local setup, TDD workflow, and pull request verification checklist
- [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md): Semantic Versioning release history

## Capability Specifications (`docs/specs/`)

- [docs/specs/cap-01-git-and-worktree-guard.md](./docs/specs/cap-01-git-and-worktree-guard.md): Git Flow, linked-worktree hygiene & 4-Layer Git Guard
- [docs/specs/cap-02-config-and-shell-free-execution.md](./docs/specs/cap-02-config-and-shell-free-execution.md): Schema-validated `.agent/sdlc-config.json` & shell-free `execFileSync` execution
- [docs/specs/cap-03-spec-adr-and-ring-alignment.md](./docs/specs/cap-03-spec-adr-and-ring-alignment.md): Spec/manifest/OpenAPI drift, human-approved ADRs & Concentric Ring checker
- [docs/specs/cap-04-single-path-measured-gate.md](./docs/specs/cap-04-single-path-measured-gate.md): Single-path (`docs-only` vs `code`) coverage, mutation & secret-scan gate
- [docs/specs/cap-05-cryptographic-merge-receipts.md](./docs/specs/cap-05-cryptographic-merge-receipts.md): Append-only SHA-256 hash chain & multi-topology HMAC-SHA256 Stage 7 receipts
- [docs/specs/cap-06-canonical-skills-and-installer.md](./docs/specs/cap-06-canonical-skills-and-installer.md): Canonical 6-skill suite, symlink-safe multi-agent installer & `doctor`

## Companion Ecosystem

- [Archlens (`https://github.com/fmatar/archlens`)](https://github.com/fmatar/archlens): Dynamic Clean Architecture Workbench, `.archlens/policy.json` concentric ring policy engine, and MCP server (`@fmatar/archlens-skill`)
